system_thesis_interpretation: This is a proposed narrowing of the paper to Level-1 initialization and bounded acquisition of one declared skill, not a runnable experiment or a positive finding. The four conditions are Level-1 plus responsive teaching, original starting point plus responsive teaching, a fidelity-to-be-established SEAL condition, and original model plus Markdown memory. Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base tensors remain frozen; intended parameter learning is confined to LoRA. Both responsive conditions learn online, so original does not mean a no-update control. The responsive contrast can at most estimate an initialization-package difference conditional on the selected starts, common teaching policy and acquisition protocol. Parent-free, file-free retention and separate capability preservation remain requirements. The original H1/H2 research spine is not replaced by a newly asserted result: this design does not identify original H2 or isolate richness from other Level-1 preparation. New L2/L3, deployment and shared-learner machinery are outside this paper scope. Historical runs and their limitations remain historical. This interpretation reconstructs the supplied proposal independently; schema validity will not establish experimental feasibility, scientific quality, fidelity, ratification or permission to implement.
graph_delta_interpretation: The added four_condition_acquisition node represents a comparison across separate learner lifetimes, not a new cognitive module. Its operational expansion is a task/feedback source feeding four isolated mutable state branches with auditable initial identities. A pinned Level-1 adapter seeds one responsive branch; an original-base start with a separately specified online LoRA state seeds the other. The Markdown branch starts from the original model, retains a versioned file, and has no adapter or optimizer learning. SEAL requires a still-unresolved boundary between its self-edit policy, inner learner adapters, reward evaluation, preparation checkpoints and final acquisition state; the composite node does not specify those edges. No branch may inherit another branch's optimizer, replay, teacher history, retrieval state or selection decisions accidentally. Common immutable base storage is conceptually distinct from shared mutable learner state. Explicit declarative state consists of permitted task/feedback records, provenance, manifests and the Markdown file; none implies a new persistent semantic graph. LoRA is parametric state, whereas prompts, draft attempts, current feedback, retrieval results and caches are temporary working state unless explicitly admitted to a permitted persistent channel. Snapshots bind each evaluated state to its lineage and update boundary; audit records can be preserved without being accessible as learner memory. The snapshot_to_sealed_evaluation edge must be one-way: a read-only evaluation fork receives the declared model state, a legitimate novel task input and no acquisition context. Its scorer holds references and scores separately from the evaluated model. Evaluation prompts, generated answers, verdicts, scores and selection signals cannot flow back into any adaptive role. Post-embargo reporting is a terminal derived-data sink, not a new curriculum edge. The separately labelled memory-assisted diagnostic needs its own explicit file-read exception and evaluator compartment; it cannot silently reuse the primary file-free edge with a file attached.
loop_delta_interpretation: The bounded_acquisition loop begins only after an exact benchmark is ratified and its applicable gates are satisfied. Before the first opportunity, task partitions, ancestry exclusions, starts, policy versions, seeds, budgets, feedback rights and checkpoint boundaries must be pinned. Each opportunity presents legal task data, records the child's attempt and allowed outcome, permits method-specific derivation of learning material, applies only that condition's allowed write, records actual resource use and seals a snapshot at a declared boundary. The two responsive policies and schedules must match, but their messages may differ responsively to distinct attempts; policy equality is not token-for-token transcript equality. In the responsive branches, provenance-admitted child-produced material may affect later LoRA consolidation only across a declared admission/update boundary; parent lesson text must not be copied into sleep bytes under the retained invariant. The exact admission, replay, optimizer continuation and update schedules remain unspecified. Acquisition attempts/outcomes may become later learning evidence through this legal boundary; sealed-evaluation attempts or outcomes never may, including after reporting. SEAL's supplied conceptual description separates self-edit generation, inner adaptation and an outer reward-trained policy; the chosen regime must determine which states reset, which persist and whether the final acquisition policy is fixed. Outer learning cannot receive final sealed results. Markdown writes persist declaratively through bounded versioned edits; file retrieval is legal only under a specified acquisition/assisted-read policy and does not consolidate into parameters. Primary retention reloads the intended snapshot in a fresh process, removing parents, files, source tables, conversation, replay/retrieval access and caches while preserving legitimate task inputs and learned adapters. Evaluation working state is discarded from the learner's accessible state, not erased from protected evidence. Thinking here is goal-directed attempt construction; dreaming is at most the existing consolidation of admitted experience. The proposal supplies no breadth-first connection-growth algorithm, graph expansion, new dream module or hippocampal mechanism. Module-level credit requires provenance linking generation, admission, update exposure and state changes; whole-system before/after scores alone cannot identify which module caused improvement. SEAL's outer reward assigns policy credit only within its separately authorized training partition; neither teacher praise nor parameter movement proves scientific benefit. Opportunities/resources, not hidden scores, determine stopping. Retry, timeout, late reply, crash/resume, overflow and interference scheduling rules must be frozen so retries cannot create undeclared extra opportunities or select survivors. Parallelism may separate independent branches/seeds, not reorder one learner's causal updates or mix mutable state. Historical GPU capacity is not a measured throughput commitment for this proposal. All numeric limits, operational failure ceilings and resource forecasts remain specification questions; none are supplied here as executable defaults.
claim_delta_interpretation: The modified r121_level1_acquisition claim is prospective and headline_eligible remains false. Evidence would need paired starting measurements, acquisition changes and budget-indexed curves, fresh-process retention, interference and capability results, uncertainty and actual cost disclosure. A higher final level alone could be inherited competence rather than faster acquisition. The responsive pair tests the selected initialization package, including its historical preparation, not richness-specific causation or improved autonomous learning after parenting ends. Comparisons to a verified SEAL regime or Markdown-assisted system are conditional method/system comparisons, not clean module ablations. Markdown-present application measures use of external memory; Markdown-absent retention is a no-parametric-retention reference, not an equally adapting learner. Superiority to that reference alone does not establish learned learning. Capability ON/OFF checks concern preservation and localization, not proof of skill retention or original H2. The retired r121_new_l2_l3_deployment claim removes prospective headline scope without deleting or retrospectively reclassifying existing receipts. Source-context historical counts, feasibility warnings and named evidence paths are not newly verified results in this interpretation. Invalid, capped, missing and failed attempts remain in declared denominators; preparation/search costs cannot be hidden behind online-only efficiency. No scientific result or runnable-benchmark approval is asserted.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: All nine proposed cells are addressed as access contracts. acquisition_feedback/adaptive_system is visible only as common legal task feedback, with method-specific consumption rules; it is not permission to ingest parent lesson bytes directly into LoRA training. acquisition_feedback/isolated_evaluator is forbidden as transcript, prior solutions, feedback caches or acquisition source material in retention evaluation; legitimate novel task inputs are not removed. acquisition_feedback/post_embargo_report is derived_only: aggregate provenance and delivery accounting, not a raw transcript feed. sealed_inputs_answers_scores/adaptive_system is forbidden to teachers, learners in adaptation mode, self-edit policies, replay/admission logic, tuners and selectors; no final-score reward or early stopping. sealed_inputs_answers_scores/isolated_evaluator is visible only after splitting scorer privilege from model privilege: the model receives task inputs and emits answers, while references and computed scores remain scorer-only. The combined information item is not permission to put answer keys in the model prompt. sealed_inputs_answers_scores/post_embargo_report is derived_only after trajectories are immutable and the embargo is released; report access cannot reopen those trajectories for adaptation or checkpoint selection. memory_file/adaptive_system is visible as persistent memory only in the Markdown condition, not as a shared channel for the other three arms. memory_file/isolated_evaluator is forbidden for primary retention, including indirect reads via wrappers, tools, filesystem paths or caches. A memory-assisted diagnostic is intended but its separate access contract is not yet represented. memory_file/post_embargo_report is derived_only, covering version hashes and the assisted-versus-file-free contrast, not general release of file contents to adaptive actors. Embargo scope across seeds/arms, intermediate checkpoint handling, scorer/model separation and assisted evaluation require explicit operational specification. Sentinels must cover indirect paths and evaluation-generated material, not just nominal prompt arguments.
acceptance_test_interpretation: No acceptance test is represented as passed; the listed evidence paths are future required receipts, not evidence inspected here. R121_partition (before implementation): require reproducible pinned enumeration of semantic equivalence classes under a declared input domain, disjoint offline/development/acquisition/interference/sealed allocations, ancestry exclusions and legal-example identifiability. Different task IDs alone do not measure novelty. The context's preliminary 97 classes versus 88 allocated is an unverified feasibility warning, not an accepted partition or proof of impossibility; establish remaining preparation needs without inspecting sealed examples. R121_seal_fidelity (before implementation): require selected primary method/version and task regime mapped to self-edit policy, outer reward training, inner update, reset/continuation and task separation under frozen-base LoRA constraints, with independent review of each deviation. A reflection/SFT loop cannot satisfy the advertised fidelity link. The scope note's citation is not a certificate and no primary-method mapping has been supplied here. R121_numerics (before implementation): freeze task counts, opportunities, policy/update budgets, ranks and optimizer rules, seeds, readout/interference schedule, Markdown capacity and write/read semantics, capability suite/margins, primary denominators and uncertainty plan. Check satisfiable replacement operations, not just nonempty fields; the cited 1024-token replacement versus 512-token slot is unresolved. Equality of nominal steps alone cannot test resource parity. R121_visibility (before gpu_run): inject synthetic sealed and acquisition sentinels across all adaptive readers, retention inputs, logs, file/tool access, caches, reward and selection paths; verify reference separation and that evaluation generations also cannot reenter updates. Exercise a separately specified assisted path without weakening primary retention. A single clean prompt fixture does not establish isolation or embargo enforcement across successive checkpoints. R121_continuity (before gpu_run): load all four pinned starts, perform synthetic allowed-channel updates and round-trip snapshots; verify frozen base hashes, active online LoRA in both responsive arms, declared SEAL state separation/reset behavior, no Markdown parameter updates, stable lineage and no cross-arm mutable sharing. 'Markdown no updates' must mean no parameter/optimizer updates, not no file edits. Adapter ON/OFF identity and fresh-process cleanup also need coverage. This measures state integrity, not successful learning. R121_accounting (before gpu_run): replay a synthetic ledger with attempted and actually consumed messages, late/missing replies, failed/capped calls, retries, edits, file reads, inner updates and offline/search work; reconcile child/teacher tokens, actual loss-bearing exposures, optimizer steps and elapsed/compute costs to immutable attempt IDs without double counting. Include crash/resume and operational stop cases, because aggregate nominal totals do not prove no extra acquisition. Synthetic accounting validates instrumentation only, not real-run cost superiority. R121_capability (before scientific_claim): bind clean-context pre/post acquisition ON/OFF panels to exact checkpoints, tokenizer/interface, code/math/tool/concise-answer suite, seeds and predeclared preservation margins; report uncertainty, invalid outputs and suppression independently from acquisition/retention. A runnable numeric protocol must predeclare this suite before implementation even though result evidence belongs at the claim gate. ON/OFF alone cannot separate all effects of initialization and acquisition, so preserve starting measurements. R121_claims (before scientific_claim): independently review matched starts and gains, retention, interference, capability, paired uncertainty, all failed/capped calls and separate Markdown-present/file-free results, with fidelity and full cost limitations attached. Permit only evidence-supported conditional system/package statements; reject causal richness, general learning or original H2 deductions from these arms. The proposal lacks a dedicated acceptance ID explicitly exercising parent-free retention, interference and paired readout alignment end-to-end; disposition is sought on making coverage explicit within the named tests or revising the test contract, not inventing an extra accepted test here.
assumptions: The exact listed context files are the complete design evidence available to this independent interpretation; references inside them have not been followed, and no other interpretation, critique, preliminary design or evidence receipt was inspected.

The later Level-1 scope constrains this proposal; older broad campaign instructions are background/invariants, not instructions to launch, inspect unrelated state, restore L2/L3 scope or contact providers during this task.
Original in the responsive condition denotes the pre-acquisition starting point, not an immutable learner; original plus Markdown alone has no parameter-learning channel.
Immutable evaluation snapshots may preserve learned state while acquisition logs remain protected audit evidence; evidence retention is not permission for evaluated models to retrieve those logs.

The scope note describes required SEAL behavior rather than demonstrating a verified local reproduction; its primary-source citation and the constraints document's retrieval gap leave fidelity unresolved.

Counts mentioned in DESIGN_CONSTRAINTS.md are attributed preliminary warnings only. No grammar, partition sizes, rank, token limits, seed count or schedule is adopted as a benchmark default by this interpretation.

Standing invariant requirements, including at least three seeds where a claim rests on a number, remain constraints on a future exact specification; this does not supply the missing power analysis or fix a runnable seed allocation.

ambiguities.question: Which exact skill grammar, input domain, semantic-equivalence rule and identifiable legal examples support disjoint preparation, development, acquisition, interference and sealed partitions? Disposition sought: a pinned reproducible feasibility receipt and explicit allocations, not hidden-set inspection or silent grammar expansion.
ambiguities.impact: The reported 97/88 arithmetic does not establish sufficient offline/development capacity or novelty, so R121_partition and a runnable benchmark remain unresolved.

ambiguities.question: Which exact Level-1 checkpoint, original base/tokenizer and clean ancestry are selected, and which adapters, optimizer moments, RNG, replay or teacher histories are inherited or reset in each condition? Disposition sought: hash-bound start manifests and ancestry/target-exposure exclusions chosen without FINAL scores.
ambiguities.impact: Unknown inheritance can confound an initialization-package comparison or violate contamination rules; neither a historical candidate nor a directory label certifies a clean start.

ambiguities.question: Which primary-source SEAL regime/version is intended, what are the policy and inner-learner state identities, and where are outer reward, reset, policy freezing and final acquisition boundaries? Disposition sought: source-to-state mapping and independent review of deviations, including compatibility with LoRA-only learning, child-authored sleep material and provenance.
ambiguities.impact: Faithful method identity and permitted update channels are unsettled. Neither offline policy training nor use of self-edits can be filled in from a generic SEAL label.

ambiguities.question: Exactly how do legal task outcomes and responsive parent feedback become child-authored examples, and what admission, replay, deduplication and sleep rules determine loss exposure? Disposition sought: an explicit permitted provenance/admission boundary for each weight-learning arm, preserving the ban on lesson text entering sleep bytes.
ambiguities.impact: The loop's broad reads/writes list alone could accidentally authorize direct teacher SFT, cross-stage feedback leakage or a different intervention from the retained invariant.

ambiguities.question: What are the exact opportunity, child/teacher/self-edit token, loss-exposure, optimizer, rank, context, latency and total resource ceilings, including preparation/search costs and responsive policy versions? Disposition sought: a frozen satisfiable budget table, primary denominator and explicit unmatched quantities.
ambiguities.impact: Common opportunities do not imply equal actual resources or identical messages, and no matched-budget learning or efficiency estimate is yet executable.

ambiguities.question: Who writes the Markdown file, when can it be edited/read, and do slots allow append, patch or full replacement under which file, write-token and context limits? Disposition sought: explicit edit/read semantics resolving the cited replacement/slot mismatch and counting every associated model call.
ambiguities.impact: An impossible replacement or unmetered file retrieval invalidates the intended external-memory control and resource comparison.

ambiguities.question: How is the memory-assisted diagnostic compartmentalized from primary retention, and how are evaluator task inputs separated from scorer-only answers and scores? Disposition sought: explicit role/stage permissions and negative tests for the assisted exception, rather than interpreting the current coarse visible cell as unrestricted access.
ambiguities.impact: The present matrix forbids the file for the sole evaluator stage, yet calls for an assisted result. Undeclared permissions risk contaminating primary retention.

ambiguities.question: Does embargo release require completion of all compared trajectories, seeds and selection decisions, and who may read intermediate or aggregate diagnostics? Disposition sought: a precise release predicate and continued prohibition on using evaluation-derived content for future adaptation on the same confirmation set.
ambiguities.impact: An immutable individual checkpoint does not freeze a still-adapting trajectory; early aggregates can leak through human or automated scheduling and selection.

ambiguities.question: What are the timeout, late-message, overflow, invalid-output, retry, crash/resume and operational abort rules, and how do they consume paired opportunities? Disposition sought: preregistered attempt accounting and deterministic state-continuation rules, with reasons and costs retained and no hidden-score selection.
ambiguities.impact: Unbounded retries or survivor-only reporting can silently alter treatment dose, pairing and stopping even when nominal ceilings appear matched.

ambiguities.question: What are the exact baseline/acquisition/retention/interference boundaries, transfer inputs, capability suite and preservation margins, including response-interface validation? Disposition sought: pinned clean-context panels and an explicit coverage assignment for end-to-end retention/interference and checkpoint alignment.
ambiguities.impact: The proposal cannot yet distinguish inherited level, learning gain, retention and suppression; a parser/interface failure could masquerade as lack of skill.

ambiguities.question: Which paired learner/task seeds, primary estimand, uncertainty procedure and floor/ceiling handling support the permitted comparison, and how are all invalid/capped calls counted? Disposition sought: a predeclared analysis and disclosure plan respecting the seed invariant without treating correlated episodes as independent replications.
ambiguities.impact: Starting differences and unequal effective sample sizes can produce an apparent acquisition advantage without evidence for the advertised conditional effect.

ambiguities.question: After the missing feasibility, fidelity and numerical decisions are resolved, which exact benchmark, visibility, tests and claim bytes will Rohin ratify and for which implementation scope? Disposition sought: the repository deliberation and human-ratification boundary on a complete revision, without inferring authority from this interpretation or standing experiment permission.
ambiguities.impact: The current artifact remains an incomplete scope proposal. No implementation, GPU run, new claim, provider action or unrelated historical-run relabelling follows from completing formal interpretation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The visibility matrix is not operationally complete for every evaluation it describes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: It combines model inputs with scorer-only references/scores in one visible item and forbids memory for its only evaluator stage while asking for a separately labelled memory-assisted diagnostic. Reasons describe intended restrictions, but stage-level permissions alone cannot enforce the distinction.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Seek explicit scorer/model and assisted/primary boundaries in the revised proposal, with test coverage bound to those permissions. Preserve the present file-free and no-feedback restrictions until that disposition; do not implement an inferred exception.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The acceptance list does not yet explicitly test the full retention/interference/readout link advertised by the claim.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Continuity, visibility and capability tests address important prerequisites, but cannot alone show a matched sequence of before/after acquisition, interference and fresh-process retention measurements. The claims review cannot repair missing measurement contracts after results exist.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Ask the revising author and adjudicator to assign explicit end-to-end coverage within the existing acceptance IDs or propose a ratified test delta, including synthetic failure cases and stage-appropriate evidence. This interpretation does not add an acceptance ID or mark any evidence complete.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The literal R121_continuity expectation 'Markdown no updates' is too broad for the stated Markdown acquisition condition.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Its intended persistent channel must permit bounded file writes, while its model and optimizer must remain unchanged. A literal prohibition on all updates would eliminate the treatment; a blanket permission would admit unintended parameter learning.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Clarify no parameter/optimizer updates versus permitted versioned file edits and verify both separately under a specified edit/read budget.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The graph's 'faithful-SEAL' label cannot yet denote a verified method implementation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The same proposal and listed constraints leave primary-regime mapping, outer-policy state and fidelity unresolved. Treating the label as an established property would bypass R121_seal_fidelity and obscure possible conflicts with the retained write/provenance invariants.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Treat the label only as a fidelity requirement pending a primary-method mapping and independent review. Any permitted reduced method needs an explicit qualified name and scoped human disposition; do not silently substitute reflection plus SFT.

open_questions: Rohin must decide the exact revised benchmark and implementation scope after task feasibility, ancestry, SEAL fidelity, budgets, partitions and numerical schedules are specified; the current proposal and this interpretation confer no runnable authorization.

Ratification must explicitly dispose of scorer/model separation, the Markdown-assisted exception, embargo release and acquisition-material admission while preserving sealed-data blindness and the parent-lesson sleep restriction unless an invariant change is separately ratified.

The revised acceptance and analysis contract must resolve retention/interference coverage, capability margins, retries, resource accounting, seeds and uncertainty before the corresponding implementation, GPU and scientific-claim gates can be evaluated.

Any deviation from the selected SEAL method or retained invariants, and the exact permitted conditional package/system claim language, require explicit disposition rather than interpreter consensus or implied authority from old experiment authorization.

This artifact is one independent systems reconstruction only. Cross-critique, adjudication, exact human ratification, scoped implementation/testing and subsequent review/gates are not performed or asserted here; existing evidence and unrelated running work remain untouched.
